latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Watermark Remover skill.

- Automatically detects and removes watermarks in image corners using AI-powered inpainting (LaMa), with fallback to OpenCV.
- Command-line interface provided via `scripts/main.py`, supporting multiple options for detection sensitivity, masking, and output locations.
- Includes a preview mode to visualize detected watermarks.
- Supports common image formats: JPG, PNG, BMP, TIFF, and WEBP.
- Recommended for use when asked to “remove watermark”, “clean image”, or “去水印”.
